idea-plugin.name: Solstice Pro
idea-plugin.description:
Solstice Pro is the animated companion for Solstice Themes. It requires the free theme plugin, keeps the Moon, Sun, and Star palettes, and adds a lightweight harbor layer that makes TODOs, bugs, ideas, and review notes easier to notice while you work.

The Marketplace screenshots may look different because each Solstice theme has its own full palette: Moon is cool blue, Sun is warm amber, and Star is deep violet. Pro features adapt to those themes instead of forcing one fixed look everywhere.

Color previews:

Solstice Sun - warm amber tabs, dark espresso editor surfaces, and copper-orange syntax accents.

Solstice Star - deep violet panels, lavender keywords, gold highlights, and a softer cosmic contrast.

Solstice Moon - cool blue sidebars, crisp cyan syntax, rose keywords, and a clean midnight editor tone.

Visual workflow features:

  • Status bar harbor pulse - a compact animated horizon with sun, moon, shimmering stars, moving water, and ripples that react softly to editor activity.
  • Editor marker badges - JetBrains-style gutter labels and tinted editor rows for explicit Solstice.BUG, Solstice.TODO, Solstice.IDEA, and Solstice.REVIEW comments so important lines stand out without taking over the editor.
  • Solstice Markers tool window - a compact marker board with priority cards, filtered counts, a cinematic harbor overview, and fast jumps back to tagged lines.

Pro feature previews:

Solstice Marker Board - compact marker counts, priority cards, a cinematic harbor overview, gutter markers, and selected marker details in one tool window.

Solstice marker actions - right-click selected code to quickly tag it as Solstice.BUG, Solstice.TODO, Solstice.IDEA, or Solstice.REVIEW.

Marker workflow features:

  • Right-click selected code and mark it as Solstice.BUG, Solstice.TODO, Solstice.IDEA, or Solstice.REVIEW.
  • Open the Solstice Markers tool window to scan all tagged lines, filter by marker type, and jump back to the source.
  • Use marker gutter actions to show details, copy marker text, move between nearby markers, or list all markers in the current file.
